title: Type Slot — one packed placement (absorbs PromoSlot / Babulus-4c7)
description:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress. Publicist accepted.

**This issue is the Slot spec.** Absorbs PromoSlot (same id). No duplicate Slot type.

## Type: Slot

When a packed Post (or AdDraft) should go. Channel `linkedin` | `x` (not Discord). Timezone America/New_York.

## Fields (design, not schema)

- **channel**: `linkedin` | `x`
- **dueAt**: America/New_York — lives here, not on LinkedIn Posts API create
- **post** or **ad_draft**
- **campaign** (optional)
- **schedulingType** (v1): always `human` / notification

## States

`draft` → `ready` → `approved` → `queued` → `posted` | `skipped`

**Ryan must approve before queued.**

**`queued` = packed awaiting Ryan click, not bot-posted.** That click is the only write to the network. Do not auto-post. LinkedIn create is PUBLISHED-only; we do not pass a schedule field.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> draft
  draft --> ready
  ready --> approved
  approved --> queued
  queued --> posted
  queued --> skipped
```

## Out of scope

- No model, UI, or connector implementation
- Nothing posts live unless Ryan says so
- Discord is not a channel
